answer: Copper inlet berth bond stops fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, claims a berth, clears three signed milestones: dredge, lay a copper line, file a ripple reading. An auditor replays the inlet ledger; a missed or reused milestone burns it. Cost 30, 36, 42: one pays 108, 1,000 fakes 178,000, above the 40,000 pool. Rented milestones fail: each copper stamp binds one identity; a second filing burns both. Honest agents pay once, keep full shares.
